title: template REJECTED webhook disables template + blocks campaign (MSG-2)

messages.body: ⚠️ WhatsApp template "j283_promo" was REJECTED by Meta (ABUSIVE_CONTENT). Campaigns using it are blocked until it is re-approved. Review the template in the dashboard and pick an approved replacement.
